articles.headline: Sun retire Jonquel Jones' No. 35 jersey in pregame ceremony
articles.description: Jonquel Jones was all smiles as her No. 35 jersey was retired by Connecticut just before the Sun played the Liberty on Monday night. She received a standing ovation from the crowd in a pregame ceremony but was a late scratch due to illness.

images.name: Jonquel Jones [600x400]
images.caption: "I want to say thank you to this organization for taking a chance on me and bringing me here," said Jonquel Jones. "Thank you to the fans. Even though it's the 'Sunset season,' there are a lot of memories here. A lot of winning that happened here."
